periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the patches are oriented near-vertically with a slight medial tilt toward the snout, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a high aspect ratio where vertical height is approximately 1.7 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering observed, with the geometric center shifted toward the superior half and a narrow extension toward the inferior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark transverse band displays a broad, shallow U-shaped curvature across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is wide, estimated at approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit smooth, continuous semicircular convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast dark fur on the tail region, which is atypical for the species; high density of light-colored organic debris (masticated bamboo) adhering to the left forelimb and buccal area.
